oracleRisk.summary: Goal3's verified portal implementation transfers approved stablecoins to a treasury and mints a configured return token through a vesting flow; it does not implement borrower collateral valuation or liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: The verified Goal3 portal accepts owner-configured stable tokens, normalizes input only by token decimals, transfers deposits to treasury, and mints the same configured return-token amount through vesting. Campaign and drop rates are fixed parameters. The verified issuance and token implementations contain no oracle, market-price input, NAV, exchange-rate quote, redemption conversion, reserve-ratio gate, or rebalancing authority, so no price-sensitive control exists to score.
